title: The Dark Future of GenZ
description:

Many employers are hesitant to hire Gen Z employees due to perceived issues with work ethic, communication, and job loyalty. Some believe Gen Z lacks patience, expects rapid promotions, and struggles with handling criticism. The preference for remote work, flexible hours, and a strong emphasis on work-life balance can also clash with traditional workplace expectations.

Additionally, Gen Z’s reliance on digital communication is sometimes seen as a barrier to in-person collaboration or professional etiquette. However, these generalizations don’t reflect the whole picture—Gen Z also brings adaptability, tech skills, and fresh perspectives. The gap lies more in generational understanding than actual capability.
